title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service
displayModel: The photograph lies on one flat plane, the disc's midplane, as the Milky Way's backing image does. Nothing in the image has depth.
coverage: Milky Way foreground stars (Gaia DR3) are removed where they show; fainter and uncatalogued stars remain.

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 2250 x 2250 px, 0.25 degrees wide, tangent projection on 188.612917, +2.188333, north up; no crop or resample.
